How it works

What you get, what you provide, what costs extra

Who it is for
Small businesses in Greater Boston that need a new website, an online store, a redesign or fixes to an existing site.
Starting price
Business websites from $1,200, online stores from $2,500, logos from $350 (USD).
Deliverables
The pages, features, languages and timeline are listed in your written quote before any work starts. Online stores include an admin area to manage products and orders.
Approval
You review the design and the finished site before it goes live.
Your part
Your texts, photos and logo (or we create them as an extra), and access to your domain and hosting if you already have them.
Extra costs
Anything outside the starting price, such as extra pages, languages or third-party platforms, is listed in your quote.
Ownership, support and handover
Agreed in writing in your quote, before you sign.

E-commerce

Online stores you can manage yourself

Online stores start from $2,500. Every store comes with an admin area where you manage your products and orders yourself.

We set up product pages, categories, the cart and checkout, and the pages customers need before they buy: shipping, returns and contact.

Branding

Logo and brand identity

A clear logo and consistent colors make a small business look established. Logo design starts from $350, and we apply your brand to your website and social media.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How much does website design cost in Boston?

With us, business websites start from $1,200 and online stores from $2,500. The price depends on the number of pages, languages and features such as booking or online ordering. You get a written quote before any work starts.

How long does a website take?

It depends on the size of the site and how quickly content and feedback are ready. Your quote includes a timeline.

Can you redesign or fix my existing website?

Yes. We redesign existing websites and fix bugs and technical problems on sites that are already online.

Can I manage my online store myself?

Yes. Every online store we build includes an admin area to manage products and orders.

Do you build websites for restaurants and contractors in Boston?

Yes. Restaurants, cafés, contractors and home-service companies are a large part of our Greater Boston work. We built the website of BHS Pro Installations in Revere.

Do you work with businesses outside Boston?

Yes. Greater Boston is where we meet clients in person, and we also work remotely with small businesses anywhere in the USA, by video call, phone and email.
